title: AlgoSensei — Adaptive DSA Tutor
blurb: The DSA tutor that guides you without giving away the answer. Delivers calibrated Socratic hints for 175+ LeetCode problems across 14 patterns. A dual-stage leakage gate (regex + semantic) enforces 0% answer reveal rate — architecturally. Includes screenshot-to-session OCR, code analysis, audio output, and progress tracking.

title: Multi-Agent Personal Productivity Assistant
blurb: A production-grade multi-agent system with 6 specialized CrewAI agents — Task Manager, Researcher, Scheduler, Analytics, Career Coach, and Controller. Transforms any task list into Eisenhower-scored priorities, a time-blocked weekly schedule, meeting prep packages, and a 30-day productivity roadmap. Real-time SSE streaming dashboard with Pomodoro timer, PDF export, and session history.

title: DQN Agent on Atari Freeway
blurb: Trained a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent from zero on ALE/Freeway-v5, reaching 73% of human-level performance (21.67 crossings/episode vs 29.6 human) after 5,000 episodes on a Kaggle Tesla T4 GPU. Implements the full Mnih et al. 2015 architecture with experience replay, target network, and Huber loss. Includes Bellman parameter experiments and Boltzmann exploration.

title: Med-Llama 3.2 — Medical Q&A System
blurb: Fine-tuned Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct on the MedQuAD dataset using LoRA (r=16, 0.9% of parameters). Achieves ROUGE-1 of 0.3359 vs 0.2547 baseline (+31.5% improvement). Safety injection automatically appends medical disclaimers across all training responses. NEFTune noise regularization prevents overfitting. Interactive Gradio demo included.

title: AI Coach Corner
blurb: A suite of 5 Claude-powered coaching tools for developers at every stage — WebPath (full-stack guidance), DevPath AI (DevOps mentor), TechPath (career navigator), PyPath (Python learning companion), and Aria (AI roadmap assistant). Live in-page AI chat widgets built on the Anthropic API with custom system prompts.

title: Smart Room Cleaning Agent
blurb: Autonomous room-cleaning simulation powered by a Simple Reflex Agent model. The agent perceives a grid environment, detects dirty cells, and applies condition-action rules to navigate and clean efficiently. Implements environment state management, performance benchmarking, and agent evaluation across multiple room configurations.
